name: TFP1
control_write: bit0 START, bit1 clear done/errors; full word writes only; accept START only idle and current successful raw generation
status_read: bit0 busy, bit1 done, bit2 any fallback, bit3 protocol error
job: bits[4:0]=raw local vertex0, [9:5]=vertex1, [14:10]=vertex2; other bits zero
results: one keep/fallback bit per triangle, retained until next START/reset; fallback whole batch in initial software; no GPU draw side effects from preflight
ownership: reserve raw read port and shared FMA/scratch for preflight; wait accepted CPU alias bursts and BIM2 copy to drain; inhibit raw START and BIM2 CLAIM while preflight active; GPU snapshot reads remain independent
reset: fabric reset cancels all; GPU import_reset must not abandon accepted raw DMA; preflight software is synchronous; preserve stable result through consumer-only reset or cancel safely after drain
arithmetic: exact current CPU reduced-FMA nine-op sequence; clip/W/equal-W and every unsupported intermediate checked before draw
job_lifetime: Job slots retain contents and initialized state until rewritten or fabric reset; software rewrites all selected jobs before START. Uninitialized/reserved/out-of-range jobs return protocol error and fallback.
gpu_reset: Consumer-only GPU reset leaves preflight execution/results intact; only fabric reset resets shared FMA or accepted raw DMA.
